Set VI Help from Help Info File (Simple).vi

Owning Palette: VI Helpeks API

The VI reads the Help Info File generated by VI Helpeks during help generation and, if allowed, saves the help information to the source VIs and palettes (.mnu files) referred in the file. Source files of other types are ignored.

Click the parameters for details

 

Help Info File specifies the path to Help Info File created by VI Helpeks during help generation.
Build Params specifies parameters for building help information.
Help Targeting specifies how the Help Path in the Source Files Help Info indicator is to be formed. The path can be presented as absolute, relative to source file (by default) or relative to a symbolic path.

0absoluteHelp Path is the absolute path to the help file
1relativeHelp Path is the relative path from the source file's folder to the help file
2<helpdir>Help Path consists of the <helpdir> symbolic path, Subfolder and name of the help file
3<userlib>Help Path consists of the <userlib> symbolic path, Subfolder and name of the help file
4<vilib>Help Path consists of the <vilib> symbolic path, Subfolder and name of the help file
5<instrlib>Help Path consists of the <instrlib> symbolic path, Subfolder and name of the help file
Subfolder. If the Help Targeting specifies a symbolic folder, the Subfolder defines the target location of the help file behind the symbolic folder.
CHM Tag mode specifies how the Help Tag in the Source Files Help Info indicator is to be formed. It can be either the path to HTML file inside the CHM file (by default) or a Keyword in the CHM file. This option is ignored if help information is build to link to individual HTML files (Link to HTML is TRUE).

0HTML FilenameHelp Tag is path to HTML file inside CHM file
1Index KeywordHelp Tag is Keyword in the CHM file
Save Params specifies parameters for saving help information.
Save to VIs specifies whether to save help information to VIs. Default is FALSE.
Save to Palettes specifies whether to save help information to palette menus. Default is FALSE.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
Link to HTML (F) specifies whether to link VI and palette help to HTML files instead of CHM file. Default is FALSE.
dup Help Info File returns the same value as Help Info File.
Source File Paths returns source file paths.
Source Files Help Info returns help information for the source files.
Help Path indicates the help file path in the format defined by the Build Params control. This value can be applied to the Help path VI property.
Help Tag indicates the identifier of the topic inside the CHM file indicated in the Help Path. It is empty if Help Path contains HTML file path. This value can be applied to the Help tag VI property.
Abs Help Path indicates the absolute path to the help file.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
